age.evidence: aged 8 -10 weeks at the time of arrival at the CIMH animal housing facility

sex.evidence: 16 female and 19 male mice ... 24 female and 23 male rats

dosing.doses_raw: 1 mg/kg (10 ml/kg) in mice; 1.0 mg/kg and 2.5 mg/kg (1 ml/kg) in rats
dosing.evidence: Psilocybin ... dissolved in sterile 0.9 NaCl for intraperitoneal (IP) administration of 1 mg/kg (10 ml/kg) in mice and subcutaneous (SC) administration of 1.0 mg/kg and 2.5 mg/kg (1 ml/kg) in rats

group_housing.evidence: All mice and rats were individually housed during self-administration procedures.

day_night_flipped.evidence: Rats were housed on a reversed light cycle (lights on: 7 pm-7 am) ... Experiments in rats were performed during the dark phase. (Mice were on a standard cycle.)

assays.assay_description: Operant chambers (Med Associates, 24.1 x 20.3 x 18.4 cm) with two levers; 1 hr daily sessions: 8 days of cocaine SA (0.5 mg/kg/14 µl IV, FR2, paired with 20 s blinking light CS), daily extinction sessions until criterion (with psilocybin 1.0 mg/kg i.p. given after the first 2 extinction sessions), and a single 1 hr cue-induced reinstatement test 24 h after extinction.

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneal (IP) administration of 1 mg/kg (10 ml/kg) in mice

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice first underwent lever training with 14 mg sweetened food pellets

setup_restrain.evidence: mice freely responded on levers in the operant chamber

food_restriction.evidence: no food was placed in the operant chamber during cocaine SA/extinction/reinstatement sessions

water_restriction.evidence: no water was placed in the operant chamber during sessions

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately following the 1st 2 extinction sessions, mice were injected with vehicle or 1 mg/kg psilocybin ... cue reinstatement was tested 24 h later

sample_size.evidence: Female VEH (n = 8) and PSI 1.0 (n = 8); Male VEH (n = 9) and PSI 1.0 (n = 10)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (1 mg/kg) administered after the first two extinction sessions had no effect on the number of sessions to reach extinction criterion or on cue-induced reinstatement in either male or female mice. Both vehicle and psilocybin groups showed significant cue-induced reinstatement.
outcomes.statistics: Female reinstatement: lever F(1,14)=8.1, p<0.05; session F(1,14)=21.0, p<0.0005; lever x session F(1,14)=12.2, p<0.005; no treatment effects (Fs<1). Male reinstatement: lever F(1,17)=27.5, p<0.0005; session F(1,17)=28.9, p<0.0005; lever x session F(1,17)=18.6, p<0.0005; no treatment effects.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin administered following extinction trials had no effect, as both female and male mice and rats demonstrated significant cue-induced reinstatement.

assays.assay_description: Operant chambers (Immetronic, 40 x 30 x 52 cm) with nose-poke ports; 1 hr daily sessions: 15 days of cocaine SA (0.8 mg/kg/36 µl IV, FR1, blue light SD + 4 s white light CS), 7 days of extinction (with psilocybin 1.0 or 2.5 mg/kg s.c. immediately after each extinction session), and a single 1 hr cue-induced reinstatement test 24 h after the last extinction session.

application_type.evidence: subcutaneous (SC) administration of 1.0 mg/kg and 2.5 mg/kg (1 ml/kg) in rats

setup_habituation.evidence: no pre-test apparatus exposure described for rats

setup_restrain.evidence: rats freely performed nose-poke responses in the chamber

food_restriction.evidence: no food accessible inside the operant chamber during sessions

water_restriction.evidence: no water accessible inside the operant chamber during sessions

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately following each of the 7 extinction sessions, rats were injected with vehicle, 1 mg/kg, or 2.5 mg/kg psilocybin ... cue reinstatement was tested 24 h following the last of the 7 extinction sessions

sample_size.evidence: Female VEH (n=8), PSI 1.0 (n=8), PSI 2.5 (n=8); Male VEH (n=9), PSI 1.0 (n=8), PSI 2.5 (n=6)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (1.0 or 2.5 mg/kg s.c.) administered after each of 7 daily extinction sessions had no effect on extinction or cue-induced reinstatement in either male or female rats. All groups showed significant cue-induced reinstatement.
outcomes.statistics: Female reinstatement: nose poke F(1,21)=56.8, p<0.0005; session F(1,21)=45.2, p<0.0005; nose poke x session F(1,21)=29.4, p<0.0005; no treatment effects. Male reinstatement: nose poke F(1,20)=31.0, p<0.0005; session F(1,20)=53.0, p<0.0005; nose poke x session F(1,20)=55.9, p<0.0005; one-way ANOVA on % active responding: F(2,20)=1.1, p>0.05.
outcomes.evidence: Female VEH, PSI 1.0, and PSI 2.5 rats did not differ in cue-induced reinstatement following extinction ... Male VEH, PSI 1.0, and PSI 2.5 rats did not differ in cue-induced reinstatement following extinction.

judge_notes: Treated species (mouse vs. rat) as separate assays per rubric ('Same test in different SPECIES = separate assays'), even though both use operant cocaine SA/extinction/reinstatement.

Within each species, merged SA, extinction, and reinstatement phases into a single assay entry (same operant paradigm, different phases of one learning protocol) per the rubric's decision rule on learning paradigms.
B1 scored as 2-3 measures (active responses, inactive responses, infusions) rather than 4-6; days-to-criterion is a derived summary, not an additional behavioural measure during recording.
D3 scored 15+ for both species: mice had 8 SA + up to ~24 extinction + 1 reinstatement days; rats had 15 SA + 7 extinction + 1 reinstatement = 23 days. Overrode glm/gptoss undercounts.
day_night_flipped scored 'yes' at the study level because rats were on a reversed cycle; this is the dominant informative housing fact, with mice on standard cycle noted in evidence.
Application route at study level is 'multiple' (i.p. in mice, s.c. in rats); per-assay routes are i.p. and s.c. respectively.
